# G11 r2 FortiOS fixture provenance

- `rib_inactive` is the failover excerpt with the selected marker and its continuation from [Fortinet redundant Internet failover](https://community.fortinet.com/fortigate-3/technical-tip-redundant-internet-connection-failover-without-load-balancing-or-sd-wan-99215).
- `rib_inactive_without_selected` preserves the suffix layout from [Fortinet inactive routes](https://community.fortinet.com/fortigate-3/technical-tip-how-to-identify-inactive-routes-in-the-routing-table-99133) with the next hop anonymized.
- `ipv6_recursive_rib` preserves the recursive IPv6 database row format from [Fortinet FortiOS 7.6 recursive resolution](https://docs.fortinet.com/document/fortigate/7.6.0/sd-wan-new-features/903267/recursive-resolution-of-bgp-routes-using-ipv6-prefix-with-on-link-flag-from-route-aggregation), with addresses anonymized. `ipv6_recursive_table` applies the installed table flag convention to the documented path.
- `ospf_neighbors` preserves the process heading and two parallel neighbors from [Fortinet OSPF troubleshooting](https://community.fortinet.com/fortigate-3/troubleshooting-tip-ospf-neighborship-in-a-full-state-but-no-routes-are-received-or-advertised-to-the-neighbor-178607), with the router ID and neighbor addresses anonymized. Both lab appliances returned an empty OSPF neighbor table.
- `r2-live.json` contains targeted read-only excerpts from the 60F (7.6.8) and IT-case (8.0.2) for `get system stp list`, `show system virtual-switch`, `diagnose netlink interface packet-rate` and `diagnose netlink device list`. Prompts were removed and STP MAC addresses anonymized.
